SECTION 4 — WHY XOFOZ

H2:​
Why Abu Dhabi businesses choose XOFOZ for software solutions

H3: Authorised Tally Prime dealer — genuine software, certified implementation​
 Content: XOFOZ is one of Abu Dhabi's authorised Tally Prime dealers — officially appointed by
Tally Solutions to supply, implement, and support Tally Prime in the UAE. Authorised dealer
status means every Tally Prime license XOFOZ supplies comes with genuine manufacturer
warranty, official update entitlement, and access to Tally manufacturer support — not a grey
market license that leaves your business running unregistered software without update access
or manufacturer backing. More importantly, Tally Prime implementation from XOFOZ is
performed by certified engineers who are formally trained on the platform — configuring UAE
VAT correctly, migrating your data accurately, training your team effectively, and providing
certified support when questions or issues arise after go-live. There is a significant difference
between purchasing a Tally Prime license from a genuine authorised dealer and purchasing
from an unregistered reseller — and that difference becomes clear at the moment your business
needs update access, manufacturer support, or compliance documentation for an FTA audit.

H3: UAE VAT configured correctly in every software implementation​
 Content: Every software implementation from XOFOZ that involves financial transactions —
ERP, POS, accounting — is configured with correct UAE VAT settings as a standard, mandatory
deliverable. Tax groups are correctly assigned, VAT rates are applied to the correct supply
types, invoice formats meet FTA requirements, and VAT reporting extracts the data the FTA
requires in the format it requires — all configured and tested before your team uses the system
for the first live transaction. UAE VAT misconfiguration is one of the most common and most
costly software implementation failures in Abu Dhabi businesses — resulting in incorrect VAT
charged to clients, incorrect VAT reclaimed from suppliers, and incorrect VAT return submissions
that attract FTA penalties. XOFOZ eliminates this risk by treating UAE VAT configuration as a
non-negotiable implementation standard — not an afterthought addressed weeks after go-live
when the first VAT return reveals the problem.

H3: Complete implementation — not software supply alone​
 Content: XOFOZ implements software as a complete service — needs assessment confirming
the right software for your specific business model, procurement from authorised distributors,
installation and configuration on all required devices, data migration from your existing system,
integration setup with other business platforms, user training for every team member who will
use the system, go-live support during the first days of live operation, and ongoing technical
support from the same certified engineers who implemented the system. Most software
problems in Abu Dhabi businesses are not caused by the software itself but by implementations
that were incomplete — missing data migration, absent training, unconfigured integrations, and
incorrect VAT setup that are not discovered until after the business has been running on the new
system for weeks. XOFOZ delivers implementations that are complete before go-live — so your
business starts on the new system correctly rather than discovering what was missed over the
following months.

H3: Single IT partner for software and all supporting infrastructure​
 Content: XOFOZ is uniquely positioned as both a software implementer and a complete IT
infrastructure provider — meaning the ERP system we implement runs on the server we
manage, backed up by the Acronis backup we maintain, protected by the Fortinet firewall we
configured, accessed over the network we designed, and supported by the same helpdesk that
manages every other IT system in your business. When your Tally Prime has a performance
issue, XOFOZ can investigate whether the problem is in the software, the server, the network,
the storage, or the user device — rather than passing the problem between separate vendors
who each confirm their own component is working correctly while the problem remains
unresolved.

FAQ 2 — Question:​
 Is XOFOZ an authorised Tally Prime dealer in Abu Dhabi?

FAQ 2 — Answer:​
 Yes. XOFOZ is officially appointed by Tally Solutions as an authorised Tally Prime dealer in Abu
Dhabi — supplying genuine Tally Prime licenses at official pricing, implementing complete ERP

FAQ 3 — Question:​
 Can XOFOZ configure Tally Prime for UAE VAT for my Abu Dhabi business?

FAQ 3 — Answer:​
 Yes. UAE VAT configuration is a mandatory component of every Tally Prime implementation
that XOFOZ delivers — not an optional addition or an afterthought. XOFOZ configures tax
groups, VAT rates, supply type classifications, invoice formats, and VAT return reporting to meet
FTA requirements for your specific business model before your team uses the system for a
single live transaction. The VAT configuration is tested with sample transactions covering your
main supply types before go-live — confirming that VAT is calculated, posted, and reported
correctly for every transaction type your business processes. Businesses that implement Tally
Prime without correct UAE VAT configuration risk incorrect VAT charged on sales, incorrect VAT
reclaimed on purchases, and incorrect VAT return submissions — all of which carry FTA
penalties that cost significantly more to resolve than a correctly configured implementation from
the outset.

FAQ 2 — Question:​
 What is the difference between Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Standard, and Premium for Abu
Dhabi businesses?

FAQ 2 — Answer:​
 Microsoft 365 Business Basic provides cloud-only access to Office applications — meaning
users access Word, Excel, and PowerPoint through a browser rather than installed desktop
applications — along with Exchange email, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. It is the lowest
cost plan and is appropriate for users who primarily need email, Teams, and file sharing rather
than fully installed desktop Office applications. Microsoft 365 Business Standard adds fully
installed Office applications on up to five devices per user — desktop Word, Excel, PowerPoint,
Outlook, and Access — making it the most commonly recommended plan for office workers who
use Office applications heavily throughout their working day. Microsoft 365 Business Premium
adds advanced security features on top of Business Standard — including Microsoft Defender
for Business endpoint protection, Microsoft Intune for device management, Microsoft Entra ID
P1 for advanced conditional access, and Microsoft Purview information protection. For most
businesses in Abu Dhabi handling sensitive data or with significant remote working populations,
Business Premium provides the most complete combination of productivity and security at a
price point well below the equivalent enterprise E3 or E5 plans. XOFOZ assesses your specific
user requirements and recommends the most appropriate plan for each user type during the
initial consultation.



FAQ 3 — Question:​
 Can XOFOZ migrate our business from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 in Abu Dhabi?

FAQ 3 — Answer:​
 Yes. XOFOZ manages complete migrations from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 for
businesses in Abu Dhabi — covering Gmail to Outlook Exchange Online migration of all emails,
contacts, and calendar entries, Google Drive to OneDrive and SharePoint migration of all
personal and shared files, Google Meet to Microsoft Teams transition with user training, and
Google Calendar to Outlook Calendar synchronisation. The migration is planned in phases —
typically migrating data first while users continue using Google Workspace, then cutting over to
Microsoft 365 once all data has been verified as successfully migrated. Every user's data is
verified for completeness before their cutover is scheduled — confirming that all emails,
contacts, calendar entries, and files are accessible in Microsoft 365 before the user is moved.
XOFOZ provides staff training on the Microsoft 365 platform before and after cutover to ensure
your team adopts their new tools effectively rather than reverting to familiar Google habits.

FAQ 6 — Question:​
 What is Microsoft 365 Copilot and should our Abu Dhabi business use it?

FAQ 6 — Answer:​
 Microsoft 365 Copilot is Microsoft's AI-powered productivity assistant built directly into Outlook,
Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and every other Microsoft 365 application — using the large
language model that powers ChatGPT, grounded in your organisation's own Microsoft 365 data,
to help your team work faster and more effectively across their everyday tasks. In Outlook,
Copilot drafts email replies, summarises long email threads, and helps manage inbox priorities.
In Teams, Copilot summarises meeting recordings, captures action items, and answers
questions about what was discussed without requiring you to watch the full recording. In Word,
Copilot drafts documents, rewrites sections, and summarises long documents. In Excel, Copilot
analyses data, creates formulas, and generates charts from natural language instructions. In
PowerPoint, Copilot creates presentation drafts from a brief description or an existing Word
document. For businesses in Abu Dhabi whose teams spend significant time in these
applications, the productivity improvement from Copilot compounds across every user and every
working day — delivering measurable time savings on the routine communication,
documentation, and analysis tasks that consume a significant portion of every knowledge
worker's time. XOFOZ assesses whether Copilot is appropriate for your specific team and
budget, implements it correctly with the data access configuration it requires, and trains your
team on how to use it effectively for their specific roles.
